name: vanborn-labs-mcp
description: MCP server for Van Born Labs data tools: YouTube scrapers, Google News, email and domain validation, ATS job listings and more. Runs Apify pay-per-event actors with your own APIFY_TOKEN.

APIFY_TOKEN.title: Apify API token
APIFY_TOKEN.description: Your personal Apify API token. Tool runs are billed to your Apify account. The server never uses a shared token.
